notes.title: Patch Notes for Wukong's Journey DLC Release
notes.notes:
Hello Generals! We hope you're having a blast with the new Wukong's Journey DLC! 

We're thrilled to see the very positive reviews (over 80%, wow!). Thanks for all the feedback, keep it coming! Now, while Wukong’s been stealing the spotlight, we’ve also been busy squashing bugs, tweaking towers, and teaching Sylvara how to hit flying things (took her a while). 

[b]Here’s the full list of changes:[/b][list]

[*] Added the Encyclopedia
[*] Favorite Customer Upgrade now works as a discount instead of a refund.
[*] Fixed a bug where modifiers wouldn't apply to Boneheart, Kosmyr or Broden.
[*] Eldritch Channeler: Fixed a bug where it would stay in its attack stance despite losing its target.
[*] Twilight Longbows: Improved bullets’ accuracy so it doesn't miss as much.
[*] Dwarven Flamespitter: Improved flamethrower's accuracy. It now recalculates enemy position at the end of the firing animation, instead of at the beginning. 
[*] Bog Hermit: Improved magic bullets’ accuracy so it doesn't miss as much.
[*] Necromancer: Adjusted attack mechanic so it doesn't spend all its saved charges when not needed.
[*] Grim Wraiths: Added a level up animation
[*] Kratoa: Is now immune to the Flaming Ground Mechanic.
[*] Kosmyr: Fixed a bug where his passive wouldn't do any extra damage
[*] Sylvara: Can now target flying enemies. Fixed the "blindspots” she had while attacking
[/list]

notes.title: Sheepy Interviews: Bamboo Masters!
notes.notes:
Hello General!

It’s me, Sheepy! I can’t believe it, I’m standing here with not one, not two, but THREE of the legendary Bamboo Masters!! I’ve been their #1 fan forever and I got all their action figures (even the super rare limited edition one) and I may or may not practice their Kung Fu poses in front of the mirror every day…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/59bdb69f79b021057a40b5fd2fdbf6ef917cef92.png[/img]
[b]Sheepy: [/b]So, how did you come to master your amazing Panda Style abilities?

[b]Chen: [/b]We are siblings who grew up under the guidance of the panda monks of the Emerald Sanctuary, where we learned that the world’s balance depended on harmony between the elements.

[b]Wei: [/b]To develop this harmony, each of us trained for years to master a unique technique: fire for determination, lightning for agility, and wind for fluidity.

[b]Hui:[/b] These secret elemental techniques have been passed down through generations of panda warriors.

[b]Sheepy:[/b] That is so awesome. How did you end up joining the Alliance?

[b]Chen:[/b] While searching for especially crunchy bamboo in a hidden valley, we stumbled upon a golden monkey devouring fruit at an unbelievable speed.

[b]Wei:[/b] Believing him to be a wandering spirit in need of help, we offered him food, only to realize he was none other than the legendary Monkey King himself.

[b]Hui: [/b]Wukong challenged us to a duel and was impressed by our kung fu prowess and insatiable appetites! From that day forward, we became allies, sharing training sessions and philosophies of combat.

[b]Chen: [/b]When the Demon Kings ambushed Wukong and stole his spheres of power, we did not hesitate to stand by his side. We’re here to restore our friend’s strength and end the demonic tyranny!

[b]Sheepy: [/b]Wow… you really are the ultimate kung fu team! Okay, I have to ask… can I get your autograph before I faint from excitement?!

Meeting the Bamboo Masters in person was even more incredible than I imagined. The Alliance is lucky to have such an amazing team… and the best part? They don’t even charge for their awesome!

[i]Sheepy out![/i]

notes.title: Sheepy’s Journal: The Calm Before the Storm
notes.notes:
[p]Hello General![/p][p]Sheepy here, reporting once again at the start of a brand new journey.[/p][p]It looked like peace was finally within reach for the Kingdom… but if my journalistic instincts have taught me anything, it’s that trouble never stays away for long! And sure enough, my Sheepy senses were right. Three demons broke loose and stole Wukong’s orbs, which puts us all in grave danger!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/8494e436ad6d80697ca659856a8d25bbc950b892.png"][/img][/p][p]As I set sail for Celestial Monkey Forest to meet (and interview, of course!) the new members of the Alliance who’ve joined us to face this threat, let me share everything I know about the quest ahead. [/p][p]First off, about where we’re heading… you may notice something strange. These “islands” aren’t really islands at all. If you look closely at the map, you’ll see that they are actually the humongous back of a giant Turtle. Wukong is good friends with it, so he’s allowed to settle on one of its peaks. But according to the Alliance’s intel, the demons who stole his orbs are far from welcome and have set up their sinister bases on the nearby islands. Rude![/p][p]And you know who else counts among Wukong’s good friends? Denas and Vez’nan! According to my sources (mostly overheard gossip), back in their youth, during their wild adventures through the Kingdom, they crossed paths with him and formed a bond that has lasted through the years. That may be why Wukong came straight to them for help in this time of need. King Denas won’t stop bragging about it.[/p][p]Oh look, we’re already approaching Celestial Monkey Forest! The shell looks even more enormous up close. I’ll be sure to bring you the Bamboo Masters interview next week![/p][p][i]Sheepy out!
[/i][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3732970/Kingdom_Rush_5_Alliance_TD__Wukongs_Journey_Campaign/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: WDC Charity Sale - Rush on and Save the Whales!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that once again, we are supporting WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation, for World Ocean Day!   

The WDC World Ocean Day Sale starts today and runs until 12th June, 10am PDT 2025, and you can save a fin-tastic 30% off Kingdom Rush, Kingdom Rush Origins, Kingdom Rush 5: Alliance, Iron Marines, Iron Marines Invasion, and Legends of Kingdom Rush. We will donate 10% of our net profits to WDC to support their conservation work.* 


[h2]Who is WDC?[/h2]
[b]WDC, Whale and Dolphin conservation[/b] is the leading global charity dedicated to the protection and conservation of whales and dolphins. 

Their expert-led teams in the UK, Europe, the Americas, and Australasia work across the whole spectrum of threats, from climate breakdown to accidental entanglements in fishing gear. They bring together, and work hand-in-hand with, businesses, philanthropists, scientists, NGOs, governments and grassroots communities to find solutions to the problems faced by whales and dolphins.
Their aim is to reverse the global decline in whale and dolphin populations by creating safe seas for these majestic creatures.

Entanglement in fishing gear, or ‘bycatch’ as it’s known, is the biggest threat whales and dolphins face. Many hundreds of thousands die in nets or get tangled up in fishing gear every year. As air-breathing mammals like us, when they get trapped in a net, panic can take over and they can sustain terrible injuries before either escaping, or suffocating. It is a massive problem and so WDC are working on some innovative solutions.  


[h2]What WDC has been doing so far 
[/h2]Working across the globe to protect whales, dolphins and porpoises from dying in fishing gear: 
[list]
[*] They’re collaborating with creel fishers in Scotland to trial new types of fishing gear to reduce entanglements of humpback and minke whales. 
[*] They’re working with colleagues and partner organisations in the Central Baltic Sea to develop a recovery plan for a critically endangered group of Baltic harbour porpoises. 
[*] On the west coast of the United States, critically endangered North Atlantic right whales are facing extinction. Entanglement is a massive threat to their survival, and WDC have been working with fishers to trial alternative gear types. 
[*] In Hong Kong WDC have been supporting local community efforts and working with fishers to save the remaining 200 Indo-Pacific finless porpoises from extinction due to bycatch.   
[*] These projects are saving lives, and they are powered by inspiring people working together for the ocean. 
[/list]

[h2]How your support will help this year
[/h2]By purchasing games from this year’s World Ocean Day sale, you will help WDC continue these vital conservation projects across the globe, as well as enable WDC’s team to embark on new efforts to bring further protections for whales and dolphins, like the Sri Lankan gillnet fisheries project: 
[list]
[*]  Sri Lanka is home to many species of whales, dolphins and porpoises as well as a myriad of other sensitive marine species like sea turtles that are vulnerable to entanglement in gillnets – these are nets that hang in the water like a wall. With funding, WDC hopes to collaborate with Sri Lankan artisanal tuna fisheries that use gillnets to trial new gear types and reduce the impact their fishing has on marine life, while still enabling them to earn their living. 
[/list]

Whales and dolphins are awe-inspiring. They are intelligent beings, vital for the health of the ocean and planet. Together we can still help them recover and flourish and they can help us reconnect with the wild, and repair the damage we have caused. 

[b]If you want to read more about WDC, you can do so [url=https://whales.org/ ]here![/url][/b]
Keep up to date with all the awesome gaming activities WDC does [url=https://games.whales.org/ ]here.[/url]
And you can find many other amazing games in the sale [url=https://bit.ly/WODSteamSale25]here.[/url]

[b]Thank you for joining us and for supporting WDC! [/b]
*10% of our net revenue from this sale will support WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation. Whale and Dolphin Conservation is a UK registered charity (no. 1014705).

notes.title: A New Hero Joins the Alliance – Meet Spydyr!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/c12b796f904222323c2b4dd03beadb4d39b88b44.png[/img]
Hello General!

Tomorrow’s the day we march against the Spider Queen and her cult. But don't squash every spider on sight just yet! Some are friendly, so put those flip flops down. Spydyr, a deadly huntress duo skilled in shadow magic, is now a part of the Alliance. Let's hear about their mission!

[b]Sheepy:[/b] “Welcome to the Alliance! Um… who of you two is Spydyr?”

[b]Spydyr: [/b]“We've been hunting together so long, we've lost track of whose mind is whose. Perhaps the shadows changed both of us. Or perhaps, we were always meant to be Spydyr.”

[b]Sheepy: [/b]“Intriguing. Did your abilities combine as well?”

[b]Spydyr: [/b]“We are shadow and silk, sorcery and web. Our Twilight Elf sight pierces the dark, catches every whisper, and makes shadow powers bend to its call. And our spider form feels the tremors of the unseen, spin its webs, and move swiftly as the wind… Together we miss nothing, no prey can escape us.”

[b]Sheepy: [/b]“Phew, so glad you’re on our side, then… why did you join our team?”

[b]Spydyr: [/b]“Whispers of the cult’s return reached the Twilight Elf Council, and so an elite team of huntresses was assembled to annihilate the Spider Queen and her followers. But as we neared the bloodsydian caves, we got ambushed. We alone emerged from the carnage. Yet our hunt remains. To finish what was begun, we now walk beside the Alliance.”

[b]Sheepy:[/b] “So you know our enemy? What can you tell us about this so-called queen?”

[b]Spydyr: [/b]“We have only faced their pawns. Fanatics lost to their worship, devotion twisting their flesh and mind. And the spiders… they are countless, an endless tide that swallows the horizon. Tell us, little sheep, do eight legs unsettle you?”

Gulp…looks like we’re in for a nightmarish encounter with the spider queen and her brood. Luckily, we have a nightmare of our own. We can only hope that with Spydyr, with their sorcery and merciless precision, they will ensure the Spider Queen web is torn apart for good.

[i]Sheepy out!
[/i]

[b]Sheepy:[/b] “Can you tell me about your kind? I’ve never met anyone like you before.”

[b]Colossus: [/b]“I come from an ancient race of beings who live a secluded life on the highest mountain peaks. For millennia, my people have engaged in deep meditation, and our energy naturally creates powerful storms around us, isolating us even further. This may be why you have never seen my kind.”

[b]Sheepy:[/b] “Why do your people choose to stay away from the world?”

[b]Colossus: [/b]“We adhered to one principle: never interfere in the struggles of organic beings. In the ancient past, we served as protectors of the land, guardians of the vulnerable. However, our interventions often resulted in destruction, leading us to retreat—not out of fear, but because we worried about the unintended consequences of our power.”

[b]Sheepy: [/b]“So, you must be the black sheep of your kind, given that you’re here.”

[b]Colossus:[/b] “Although I am 900 years old, I am still considered young for my species. Curiosity led me to explore the kingdom below. I was alarmed by what I found: the cult had returned and was causing enormous suffering in the land. I hurried back to my elders and urged them to resume our role as protectors, but they refused to listen. I knew then that I had to follow my calling to join the Alliance.”
Sheepy: “That was a major decision! I imagine it has its own challenges.”

[b]Colossus: [/b]“Yes. My great power isn’t fully under my control. I can unleash powerful storms in battle, but I risk draining my energy entirely. I must tread carefully, or risk consequences.”

[b]Sheepy:[/b] “We’re glad to have you on our side. We’ll take good care of you!” 

So, that’s it for the Surge Colossus. An amazing being with a heart full of determination and an ancient power yet to be fully mastered. Let’s welcome him to the Alliance with open hooves! Until next time…

[i]Sheepy out!

notes.title: An interview with Sylvara!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/78b2a359f27495726000c616763acd96a34b3d1c.png[/img]
Happy Thanksgiving, General!

I’m about to host a dinner interview with Sylvara, the Arborean Dragon who just teamed up with the Alliance to tackle the new pesky Crocodile plot. 

The table is beautifully set among the trees, and the veggie turkey looks baa-rilliant! Let’s dig in and see what stories she has to share.

[b]Sheepy:[/b] "Thanks for sitting with me, Sylvara! Can you tell me about the enemy we’re about to face?"

[b]Sylvara: [/b]“That is a long story, little mutton… It goes back to the Beginning of Times. Once the world was created by three Primordials, the lesser beings came to existence, to fill the world with life, form, ideas… you call them different names: incarnations, avatars, gods. The Light, the Life, the Dark, the Flame, the Ice… and many more. And among these… was me… and him. We both served the same purpose – to maintain balance in the living nature. I was the growth, and he – consumption…’’

[b]Sheepy:[/b] “Does he have a name?”

[b]Sylvara: [/b]“He did, but once he abandoned us and became what he became, he was no longer the same. He became… an abomination, and hence we call him… Abominor”

[b]Sheepy: [/b]“What happened? please tell!”

[b]Sylvara: [/b]“For countless centuries, we maintained balance in the natural world. But then he discovered the thrill of devouring everything around him. And so his primal urges consumed what remained of his sanity. As he feasted on everything which he laid his claws on… he grew larger and larger, threatening to overwhelm all we hold dear. We had to stop him”

[b]Sheepy:[/b] “How did you manage that?”

[b]Sylvara:[/b] “Abominor became so large, his soul became a melting furnace and his blood became a venom, even my powers were not enough. I had a little help from my friends, I can even say children, the Ancient Arboreans. Their shamans channeled the energy of nature through me, and together we casted a powerful Seal to put Abominor into imprisonment. It worked beautifully... until now, when it seems a few too many croks got the bright idea to let him out.” 

[b]Sheepy: [/b]“What? Why would they want to set such a monster free?!”

[b]Sylvara: [/b]“Oh… they believe it is their duty to feed their master and think freeing him is their ultimate purpose. We cannot allow this to happen. Even now, I can feel the Seal faltering beneath the raw power of his hunger…”

[b]Sheepy: [/b]“That’s terrible! How can you stop this?”

[b]Sylvara: [/b]“I cannot do this alone. We must rally our allies and stop the croks. Every creature that cares for balance, or life itself, must join together. Today, during this feast, let’s not just enjoy nature’s bounty, but plan our strategy. The world itself needs our protection once again”.

As the sun dipped below the horizon, casting a golden hue over the trees, we finished our Thanksgiving meal surrounded by tiny arboreans, filled with the purpose of protecting all we hold dear. 

After all, the Kingdom is too good a place to end up as Abominor's all-you-can-eat buffet!

notes.title: The Legend of the Devourer of Worlds
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/dd96e536180a4a525af461243d2efbc60d27edcc.png[/img]

The tiny Arborean nestled into his cozy bed of leaves, his wide eyes looking up at Old Nym.

“Grandma, tell me a story before I sleep,” he whispered.

“One of the Ancient Kings? Warriors? Lovers?” Old Nym replied.

“Ew, not lovers!” the little Arborean shook his head. “A Scary Story. Those are my favorites!”

"Oh, my sweet summer child… what do you know about Fear? Fear was the time of the Great Hunger. The Ancient Time, when He roamed the world. A long, endless night, where he devoured the trees, the stars, even the sun itself."

The baby Arborean’s eyes grew wide, but he held still, listening intently.

"Legend says he was taller than the biggest mountains, more ancient than the roots of the oldest trees. And his hunger was insatiable. He was destined to grow until he consumed our entire world until nothing was left but the void."

Old Nym leaned closer, her voice a low whisper.

"But worry not, my little dear... we Arboreans bound him with a powerful Seal, an old magic spell that secured him in eternal slumber, so he would never threaten our world again."

“Now sleep, little one. Nothing will hurt you.”


She tucked him in, her gaze lingering on the stars outside the window. The night felt peaceful, but as she stared into the dark forest, she couldn’t shake the feeling that something lingered in the air—something ancient, almost forgotten… and hungry.

notes.title: Behind the Wand: Meet Stregi!
notes.notes:
Hello, General! How's the spooky season going for you?

Today, we have a truly magical guest—one of the newest and most enchanting members of the Alliance Ranks. Yes, I’m talking about the pumpkin spice latte lover,  Stregi, the unmistakably tiny gnome witch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/58814f5c207d1d3fe14c3ca0293e23f70e70542b.png[/img]
​
[b]Sheepy:[/b] “Should I be worried about turning into a frog during this interview?”

[b]Stregi:[/b] “A frog? Oh, please! Those are so last season! I’m thinking... pumpkins! Or maybe just a few extra whiskers. Care to find out?”

[b]Sheepy: [/b](laughs nervously) “I think I’ll pass on the whiskers, thanks! How about you tell me why you joined the Alliance instead?”

[b]Stregi: [/b]“Let’s just say things got a little too serious when Navira and his undead army started marching through our forest. I grew up on tales of Razz, learning that even the tiniest gnomes can pack a punch, so I pulled out a few tricks of my own to protect our home!”

One of Stregi’s approached Sheepy, rubbing against their legs with a soft purr.

[b]Sheepy:[/b] “Aww, so cute! These cats you summon... where did they come from?”

[b]Stregi:[/b] “I found them as kittens, abandoned deep in the Faery Forest. Most thought they were too wild to handle, but I saw something special in them. They’re like me—powerful, a bit misunderstood. So, I raised them as my familiars, and we’ve been inseparable ever since.”

[b]Sheepy: [/b]“You said your're misunderstood. How so?"

[b]Stregi:[/b] “Oh, where to start? Outsiders see me pulling pranks and panic—‘stay away from her!’ My gnome friends share in the fun, but when it comes time to defend the forest, they get all nervous. Gnomes like peace, but sometimes you need a bit of sparkle to deal with real threats! I just like to do things my way!”


As I thanked Stregi for her time and turned to leave, I felt a tingle on my head. Reaching up... I had... cat ears?! I spun around, and Stregi chuckled. With a flick of her wand and a few sparks, the ears vanished. “Just harmless fun, Sheepy!” .

Looks like the Alliance is getting more colorful by the day!Who knows what manner of amazing heroes will join us next?
[i]Sheepy out![/i]

notes.title: A Chat with the Battle Brewmasters!
notes.notes:
Did you receive your invitation, General?

We’re just in time for the grand opening of the Brewmasters Artisanal Shop!

With a huge grin, King Denas raised the majestic Sword of Elynie and called, “Let the fun begin!”.  In one swift motion, he sliced through the bright ribbon, and the crowd erupted in cheers. The doors swung open, inviting everyone to dive in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/f8d7f0f9e98023f448f70b83e0ba7ce8858a58d2.png[/img]
[b]Sheepy: [/b]“Congratulations on the inauguration! How's business shaping up?”

[b]Obelax:[/b] “Thanks, Sheepy! With King Denas here, we’ve got a full house! And it's not only local Northeners—customers are flocking in from all corners of the Kingdom: Linireans, elves, dwarves, and yes, even a few zombies!"

[b]Sheepy: [/b]“How is the Northener Independence going since signing the treaty?”

[b]Halfdan the Blunt: [/b]“It's going quite well! We’ve formed a Council of Elders with both men and women from various clans, each democratically elected to support our autonomous government.”

[b]Obelax: [/b]“The Council decided to make the Battle Brewmasters Artisanal Potion Shop the official meeting place for all their gatherings! After all, a little potion fuels collaboration...

[b]Sheepy: [/b]“That’s wonderful news! So, what are your goals for the future?”

[b]Obelax: [/b]“We’re setting aside part of our production in case the Alliance needs us again soon. You know us... we always save some for battle! But we also have our sights set on expanding—if this shop does well, we hope to create a franchise of Brewmasters Craft Shops across the Kingdom. ”

[b]Halfdan:[/b]  “But before you go, Sheepy… how about you take a sip… if you dare!”

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/7cf803fb022e420be56fddb3aff13d32775c8ebb.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/7cf803fb022e420be56fddb3aff13d32775c8ebb.png[/img][/url]
As I wrap up this chapter of Interviews, dear readers, I must say it has been a joy to share these jorney with you—from the formation of the Alliance to the hard-won victory over the Overseer. 

But fear not, this isn’t farewell! Your favorite ovine reporter will be back in action, microphone in hoof, ready to cover whatever thrilling tales the Kingdom throws my way next! 

Until then... Sheepy out!

notes.title: An interview with Therien
notes.notes:
Welcome, General, to this week's interview with the Alliance ranks!

I must admit I’m anxious about this one. The voidmancer Therien is as powerful as she is eerie—her mere presence unsettling. She barely spoke to anyone at the Alliance camp, and the whispers about her were terrifying. 

Her knowledge of the Void and the Overseer dimension is crucial for the Alliance’s success, so let’s meet this enigmatic hero who saved us all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/6c650ba1d61055f8897c0e74809ef1a9ab94b493.png[/img]

[b]Sheepy: [/b]“Hello Therien! We finally got a chance t-”

[b]Therien:[/b] "You stare at mere shadows when the void is right behind you..."

I turned, startled to find the actual Therien behind me, staring down at me with knowing purple glowing eyes. I knew I should waste no time.

[b]Sheepy: [/b]“What led you to the path of voidmancing?”

[b]Therien: [/b]“ While my brother infiltrated the cult as a spy, I sought to understand the darkness we would face. I knew we had to delve into the cult's source of power if we were ever hoping to dismantle them.”

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/11d52bcb0372bf7ee7c2a232cc3937b0d98efba6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/84e6095e677f6f62971d26b0247179f8c5d85139.png[/img][/url]

[b]Sheepy: [/b]“So, you embraced the void to fight it?”

[b]Therien:[/b] “Indeed. The void holds unfathomable knowledge, but it tests you. Most who attempt to face it go insane when the void stares back.. but I learned to harness its strength. With every lesson, I grew closer to confronting our enemy.”

[b]Sheepy: [/b]“What will you do now that the Overseer is defeated?”

[b]Therien: [/b]"Now that the threat is no more, I will continue to harness my grasp, guarding against any future threats that may emerge. The sky is not the limit, little sheep. See that you remember that.”

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/5fae548fc7c9a6840db906c8314ec27d08f901b9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/eb9c0bf675e0ae9d42cd96651ba53e7bfb95a64f.png[/img][/url]

Phew! The interview is over. When your ally is a voidmancer, you really have to “watch your back”. But enough about the dark and mysterious! 

Next week, I’ve got an exciting invitation to the grand opening of an artisanal craft potion shop. I can’t wait to snag an interview with the brewmaster himself.

Sheepy out!

notes.title: Sheepy's Talk with Kosmyr 🐉
notes.notes:
Hello General!

Today I'll be interviewing none other than [b]Kosmyr, the powerhouse of the Dark Army. [/b]This is the dragon who made the Overseer’s armies tremble with his raw power. Let’s see what he has to say!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/91d3f8186b1578c0af9a4039559188bb695bd67a.png[/img]

[b]Sheepy: [/b]“Thanks for meeting me! What led you to join the Alliance?"

[b]Kosmyr: [/b]"I ONCE RELISHED A QUIET, ISOLATED EXISTENCE IN THE DEEP SHADOWS OF THE FORSAKEN CANYON. BUT THE CULT INFESTED MY DOMAIN, LURED BY THE BLOODYDIAN'S CONNECTION TO THE OVERSEER DIMENSION. FORCED TO ABANDON MY SANCTUARY, I JOINED FORCES WITH THOSE WHO WOULD HELP ME RECLAIM MY HOME."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/1a8fb4b14a595de8cf198ff37d490be48fe7b7ea.png[/img]

[b]Sheepy: [/b] "Glad that you've reclaimed your territory! I'm curious, though—are you the only gem dragon? I’ve yet to encounter another like you."

[b]Kosmyr: [/b]“I WASN’T ALWAYS LIKE THIS. ONCE, I WAS A REGULAR DRAGON UNTIL I ENTERED THE BLOODSYDIAN CAVES. THE CHAOTIC VOID ENERGY OF THE CORRUPTED MINERAL TRANSFORMS EVERYTHING IT TOUCHES, INCLUDING ME. OVER TIME, MY EXPOSURE TO THOSE CRYSTALS ALTERED MY FORM AND GRANTED ME POWER".

[b]Sheepy: [/b]“That’s fascinating, Kosmyr. With the cult vanquished, do you plan to return to your lair?"

[b]Kosmyr: [/b]"I WILL ASSIST THE ALLIANCE IN DISPOSING OF OUR FOES… FOR A TIME. BUT ONCE THE KINGDOM IS REESTABLISHED, I SHALL RETREAT TO MY CAVE. I HAVE MUCH TO ATTEND TO—DEMOLISHING THE CULT'S STRUCTURES AND DECIDING WHICH ONES WILL REMAIN.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/7cf803fb022e420be56fddb3aff13d32775c8ebb.png[/img]
And there you have it! Even a formidable, one-of-a-kind dragon can't resist a fresh start and a little home renovation. After all, there's no place like home!

Stay tuned, as we still have a few more interviews to come. Who are you looking forward to hear of next?

[i]Sheepy out![/i]

notes.title: Vez'nan and Denas Interview 👑
notes.notes:
I can't believe it! It's THE GENERAL!

I have to say I’m a big fan. You're the Kingdom's hero! Don't you get swarmed with autograph requests every time you step out the door?

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/c98c52948edcb136538fc9265bd80c304df6d918.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/fb97396d0653efbc5575083ca9178875b70764d4.png[/img][/url]

Let me regain my composure and tell you all about the Kingdom's state...

With the threat from the Overseer now vanquished and King Denas restored, the atmosphere in Linirea is positively electric. The unity forged within the Alliance has profoundly impacted the realm's harmony.

Despite my ongoing recovery from the battlefield injuries I sustained, I am back with an exclusive interview featuring none other than the Dark Lord and King Denas. Let's see what the big-shot leaders have to say!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/bf0d3f771a504eff0d1bef7da32e97bc857dd924.png[/img]

[b]Sheepy: [/b]“Let’s start with the questions everyone is asking. Will the Alliance remain now that the Overseer's defeated?”

[b]Denas: [/b]“People that toast together, triumph together, I always say! And our armies have surely done a lot of toasting and bonding over the endless celebrations of victory. They are like to reunite to face any shared foes!"

[b]Vez'nan: [/b]"If they wish to band together once again, I would not object."

[b]Sheepy:[/b] “Denas, how does it feel to once again ascend to the throne?”

[b]Denas: [/b]“I'm back with a bang! I learned some solid life lessons - like partying while there's a big-eye monstrosity is dwelling in your basement is a bad idea. See this toned bod? Top-notch shape! And take a look at this beauty of a magic sword to match - none other than the Sword of Elynie!"

Denas swung the magical sword extravagantly in the air.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/241897ffb16aabcdf74041b340e5eaa48a8e16c2.gif[/img]

[b]Vez’nan: [/b]“Yes, yes, we all saw it, very nice … as for myself, I have more important matters to attend to. Pacts to sign, powers to absorb, curses to challenge. True knowledge, might and magic. Not politics.”

[b]Sheepy: [/b]"How do the other Realms in the Kingdom fare?"

[b]Denas: [/b]“We signed a treatise.  Hammerhold shall be liberated, Malik appointed as their ruler. The North and Dwarven territories are to be returned to their rightful inhabitants. The lands beyond the mountains will stay under Vez'nan's reign, but we must enact laws to curb the surge in undead numbers.”

[b]Vez’nan:[/b] "More politics. Yet again, I'm dragged into earthly affairs."

[b]Sheepy: [/b]“One final inquiry for the Dark Lord. Your understanding of the Void was crucial in our triumph. How did you get such knowledge?"

[b]Vez’nan: [/b]“My sources run deep, delving into shadows long forgotten. In my youth, I crossed paths with the Overseer himself...but that is a story for another time. I have matters to attend now.”

[b]Denas:[/b] “What a cliffhanger! You always knew how to be mysterious, dear foe!”

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/1738a5382a02b1ef39e11d6f162104cc7a0576c0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/3e4c01e3e0553d27225497db179c9d6c0319d3c7.png[/img][/url]
So, there you have it! It appears that the Kingdom has at long last found peace. It sounds almost TOO good to be true, doesn't it? But enough dwelling on uncertainties, let us savor this peace while it lasts.

Before I go... General, would you mind autographing my tie?

[i]Sheepy out![/i]

notes.title: The Alliance Prepares for Battle!
notes.notes:
Greetings, General!

Have you heard the command? Vesper and Raelyn are reading the troops to finally march to battle in only 2 days! I've been tasked with something new: a roll call to make sure our troops are good to go! Join me as we take a stroll through the camp and check in on our soldiers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/78b7f7c6e99aa381ce59c4ced579245cc501b17b.png[/img]

The clashing sound of swordplay filled the Linirean Camp as the Paladins sparred under the approving gaze of Lumenir. Catching sight of me, they quickly lined up.

[b]Sheepy:[/b] "How are we feeling about the upcoming battle?"

[b]Paladin: [/b]"We Stand at The Ready! For Honor and Glory!"

I nodded in agreemenet and continued to the next group.

Vesper’s indications of “Ready, aim… FIRE!!” led the Royal Archers in their target practice. Each time they fired, hell drew loose on a wildbeast dummy positioned at a distance. The poor thing was almost unrecognizable at this point.

[b]Sheepy: [/b]"How's the training going? Everything in order over here?"

[b]Vesper: [/b]"Bulls-eye after bulls-eye! Ready to march and find our King!"

I finally decided not to bother the Arboreans, Elves and Wizards, who sat deep in meditation under a big tree, at peace with whatever challenges may arise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/612972e4c87e64c0a64b54410e885751476c3b8c.png[/img]

For all the differences they claim to have, the sounds at Dark Amy camp were not much different.. one sword clashing sounds much like another!

The Demons from the Pit and Shadow Archers lined up for my inspection.

[b]Shadow Archer: [/b]"We'll Show Them No Mercy!"

[b]Demon: [/b]"Can we go back to the Lava Pool now...?"

The camp tinkerers ran around busily , oiling and checking up their war machines to ensure everything was in tip-top shape before the big day.

[b]Sheepy:[/b] “How fares the war machinery on this side of the camp?”

[b]Chim: [/b]“We’re checking one last time. Technical difficulties will not do!”

[b]Churri:[/b] “Buckle up! This is the third "last time". Bet there will be ten more if I know my cousin!"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/f1874511db2d6b74b5122932a834969481879155.png[/img]

Seems like everything's good to go... for now! 

I have to admit though, as the big battle day creeps closer, my stomach churns with a bundle of nerves and excitement alike. 

Think about all the cool interviews I might snag as we head into the thick of it all! Can't you wait to see what stories unfold on our adventure?

notes.title: An interview with Anya
notes.notes:
Welcome, General, to our exclusive interview with the Alliance ranks!

Today, we have a highly anticipated guest! We're meeting Anya, the shadow hunter who bravely battles the dark forces in the realm.

At the agreed time, a cauldron of bats appeared, beckoning me to follow. I trailed their fluttering wings, leading me to the heart of the Linirean camp, where I found Anya engaged in a tranquil conversation with... a SPECTER?! 

Dante: "You look like you've just seen a ghost!"

Anya: "Dad, stop teasing them... they HAVE!"

The air rang with laughter as they poked fun at my bewildered expression.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/e4f9ae0ff86986913dc3251fab0dd001d462188e.png[/img]

Sheepy:  “Thanks for meeting me, Anya. And wait, the legendary vampire hunter, Dante? Is it really you? Are you... dead?

Dante: "Do I look alive to you? I was the best at what I did, but vampire hunting has many occupational hazards.  When I died, my spirit chose to remain in this plane, to watch over my little girl.”

Anya: "I've got this, Dad! You and Mom prepared me well. Hunting is my business too. But your guidance and company are always appreciated."

Sheepy: “Anya, what led you to follow your Father’s steps?

Anya: “Being the child of a Vampire and a Hunter wasn't easy. My parents kept me hidden to protect me, all while teaching me to use my vampiric powers for good. When my father passed, I was ready to carry on his mission and legacy.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/f30669b8d71519633aa3add6856c7379ad3b835d.png[/img]

Sheepy: “How does being a half-vampire influence your hunting?"

Anya: "It's simple. It grants me the power to hunt those who deserve it."

notes.title: Tensions are rising in the Alliance...
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/f1874511db2d6b74b5122932a834969481879155.png[/img]Hello, General!

The Alliance is preparing for its march, with tensions beginning to surface... 

Just today, during my morning stroll, the sounds of a heated argument caught my attention.

The clash of voices drew me closer until I found myself at the center of a fierce quarrel between the Arcane Wizards and Necromancers, two of the most powerful mages in our Alliance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/1ae855abf2d76102ab22d1ae5a9e654bea524809.png[/img]

[b]Arcane Wizard: [/b]"Mind your tongue, or I’ll polymorph it into a frog! Your dark arts but twisted shadows compared to the splendor of our true, High Magic!"

[b]Necromancer: [/b]"You think so highly of your feeble tricks? Nature bends to our will, death itself bows before us. Show some respect before true power!"

[b]Arcane Wizard:[/b] "Ah, look, the Sheep reporter graces us with their presence. Settle it for us, Sheepy. Who truly wields the mightiest magical craft?"

[b]Necromancer: [/b]"Ha! Even this wooly observer could see you for a fool. Tell them how darkness reigns supreme."

And just like that, they made me a part of it! Perhaps a moment of quick journalistic wit could be the key to emerging unscathed from their conflict.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/ab1b70b63e6a780cd77c5860353af3431cd89345.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/4d2272d4b1bd311540dcddc968304679b116e5a6.png[/img][/url]
[b]Sheepy: [/b]"Let's settle this like civilized people. Present your best spells and make your case for why you deserve to be known as the most powerful order in these lands."

[b]Arcane Wizard: [/b]“Order, ancient as Time and Magic itself, harnesses the purest essence of Magical Energy through crystals and age-old runes, conjuring the deadliest enchantments known to mortals.”

To demonstrate, he disintegrated a nearby tree branch into ashes, leaving me startled.

[b]Sheepy:[/b] “Has your Order remained  unchanged for such a long time?”

[b]Arcane Wizard: [/b]"In our pursuit of enlightenment, we always seek to refine our knowledge, runes, and spells. While we delve into new incantations, we remain vigilant, and wary of the shadows. We have learned as much from the missteps of Sorcerers, who recently succumbed to the allure of darkness.”

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/ae6bb02d3c80d9605d5151f2356eb2d539840f76.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/49f08c933dde12bb9ed3410aabb5d802d5a035c6.png[/img][/url][b]Necromancer: [/b]“Buufoon! You deny the darkness in your soul! You deny your POWER!! ! We hold command over an infinite undead army, rising from the corpses of our enemies. Can you match that?”

With a swift motion of his staff, a green flame of light resurrected the tree branch into a pitiful crawling stick skeleton.

[b]Sheepy:[/b] “I recall seeing you on the opposite side. How did you end up aligning with the Dark Army?”

[b]Necromancer: [/b]“Our Orders are not pawns to be toyed with by Kings like lesser beings. We are strategic. We play both sides so that we always come up on top.”

Both magicians looked at me, and I suddenly faced the daunting task of choosing the mightier faction. How could I get out of it?

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/de370560e81bd29dcba827f15af3e9e2596eda9a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/03790f97bc7be6d1f992ddadb0d38578e0b62ee7.png[/img][/url][b]Sheepy:[/b] "Power isn't about raw strength, it's about finding balance. When light and darkness team up, magic is at its best! So, keep working together in our dear Alliance, who knows what kind of cool stuff you could do next!"

None seemed too convinced with my verdict, but with that, I made my swift escape, leaving the magic users to ponder. I better watch out where I walk next time!

[i]Sheepy out![/i]

notes.title: Lunch Break with Torres
notes.notes:
Rise and shine, General!  

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/8a0edb71fa49a34d47b944e8c6f4f15fa4ed48a5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/7cf803fb022e420be56fddb3aff13d32775c8ebb.png[/img][/url]

The sun is shining, the birds are singing, and the swords are clashing as sweaty troops train for the battle to come.  

Today, I'm asked to join Torres, the best construction worker in the Alliance, on his lunch break by the river. The man's been so busy working to fortify our defenses, that I've only just now had a moment to interview him!

Watching from afar, I noticed Torres deep in conversation with... a construction beam? While an unconventional sight, it was clear that he had found an unlikely companion in the solitude of his day.

[b]Armando:[/b] "Seems we got a visitor today. Wooly loves to talk, you know?"

[b]Wooly:[/b] ... ... ...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/6803962c8d1700e094dee362f7f0c6731c69855a.jpg[/img]
[b]Sheepy: [/b]"Thank you for sharing your Lunch Break with me! Can you tell me how a man like you ended up fighting in a war?

[b]Armando: [/b]"My place was always building towers, not brandishing swords. I found myself weary of standing by, just watching others in the thick of battle, you know? Linirea needed more from me. So, when things grew dire, I thought to myself, 'No more,' and brought my humble tools to the fight."

[b]Wooly:[/b] ... ... …

[b]Sheepy: [/b]"Your fellow workers claim you're the best builder in the kingdom. Is that true?"

[b]Armando: [/b]"Those cheeky rascals, they've got a soft spot for me, and truth be told, it goes both ways."

He reflected for a moment on their claims.

[b]Armando:[/b] "I may be a simple man but I know towers like the back of my hand. I've spent more years placing with bricks and stones for the Linirean defenses than I care to remember. Oh, and I've sauntered through the Kingdom too, soaking up wisdom from every nook and cranny of those fine architectures"

[b]Wooly: [/b]... ... ... !!!! 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/b37c82f4d6c9a1b2787f08d58c130300828369db.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/60fb551c259226d5f8d61de2c1ebde7345800fae.png[/img][/url]
Armando's down-to-earth wisdom not only warmed my heart but also sparked a hunger for more than just his (very delicious) lunch break sandwiches.

If a humble man and his trusty stick sidekick could leave such a mark on the Kingdom, then who's to say a little reporter sheep can't do the same?

[i]Sheepy out![/i]

notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/de370560e81bd29dcba827f15af3e9e2596eda9a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/03790f97bc7be6d1f992ddadb0d38578e0b62ee7.png[/img][/url]

Hello, citizens of the Kingdom! 

Today, we're delving into the secrets of the Cult with an exclusive interview featuring Grimson, the elusive Twilight Elf who broke free from their grasp... at least for the most part.

I knew I would find him on the Dark Amy camp, but I couldn't have known how grim his lair would be. Adorned with half-chewed bones of countless animals, it exuded an aura more fitting for a beast than an elf. A cloaked figure emerged from the shadows to greet me:

[b]Grimson: [/b]"THE SHEEP SEEKS ANSWERS."

A skin-tearing noise echoed loudly, as a purple, one-eyed creature emerged from Grimson's back, as if in the most grotesque of horror movies.

[b]The Entity:[/b] "BE QUICK ABOUT IT, OR BE A SNACK."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/2c278afb8eae764832204f4f259d220f0dd7b576.jpg[/img]

I dashed through my notes, dreading the thought of joining the scattered bones.

[b]Sheepy: [/b]"How did you become entangled with the cult?"

[b]Grimson: [/b]"I WAS A WARRIOR, DISPATCHED BY THE TWILIGHT ELF COUNCIL ON A RECON MISSION TO INVESTIGATE THE ESCALATING CULT ACTIVITY IN OUR TERRITORY. YET I FELL INTO THEIR TRAP. THEY LOCKED ME IN THEIR DARK DUNGEONS... AND WORSE. "

[b]Sheepy: [/b]"Is that ho​w you acquired your abilities?"

[b]Grimson:[/b] "I WAS FORCED TO PARTICIPATE IN A DARK RITUAL, A TWISTED CEREMONY DESIGNED TO TRANSFORM ME INTO AN ABOMINATION. THE PAIN WAS INDESCRIBABLE, AND CORPSES OF THOSE WHO DID NOT SURVIVE LITTERED THE FLOOR AROUND ME. BUT I MANAGED TO RESIST BEING CONSUMED BY THE MONSTROUS ENTITY." 

Grimson shared how, with the Overseer entity now a part of him, he gained the power to shapeshift and flee his imprisonment, at a dire cost. This newfound ability came with a price that would forever alter his existence.

[b]Sheepy: [/b]"If you're two beings inside one body... who of you is in charge?"

[b]Grimson:[/b] "IT TOOK US TIME, BUT WE MADE OUR PEACE. WE WORK TOGETHER NOW. I MOSTLY MANAGE TO RETAIN CONTROL. BUT WHEN I’M IN EXTREME DANGER, IT SEEMS TO TAKE OVER AS A BASE INSTINCT FOR SURVIVAL."

[b]Sheepy: [/b]“What makes you fight for the Alliance?”

[b]Grimson: [/b]"I MUST DISMANTLE THE CULT. THE ATROCITIES THEY HAVE COMMITED ARE BEYOND COMPREHENSION. WITH MY FIRSTHAND KNOWLEDGE OF THE OVERSEER, AND MY SISTER'S SECRETS OF THE VOID, WE SHALL TEAR THEM DOWN."

[b]The Entity: [/b]"DON'T ACT LIKE THAT'S THE ONLY THING THAT MATTERS TO US. FIGHTING ALSO MEANS A FEAST OF FLESH! EYES! LUNGS! TASTY TREATS!!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/f1874511db2d6b74b5122932a834969481879155.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/3a1acc66324160649b719c283e2f2c4f15443d84.png[/img][/url]

As I took my final leave from Grimson, I could not help but feel a profound sense of respect for the indomitable spirit that resided within them, a testament to the enduring power of the human (or in this case, elven) will. 

It is an undoubtable advantage to have a piece of the Overseer himself fighting in our side to stop him. A wonderful ally, yes. Yet... I'll keep well away from his den!

notes.title: Meet the Grim Wraiths
notes.notes:
Welcome, General, to this week's interview with the Alliance ranks!

I’m not gonna lie, I’m a bundle of nerves for today’s meeting with the[b] Grim Wraiths, the frightening specters that fight even after death.[/b]

Perhaps I should call in sick for the day…? No, no, I won’t back down! Courage runs through the wool of my ancestors, brave sheep all of them!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/5fae548fc7c9a6840db906c8314ec27d08f901b9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/eb9c0bf675e0ae9d42cd96651ba53e7bfb95a64f.png[/img][/url]

And so, despite my nerves, I made my way towards the Dark Army camp. 

The Wraith’s Mausoleum was an ominous structure to behold. It shined with an ethereal glow that seemed to defy the laws of nature.

The air became cold all of a sudden, and a shiver went down my spine.

[b]Wraith: [/b][i]"Another fleeting soul seeks audience with the timeless wraiths..."[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/9243707a3a008d545e98cb8863251b12825fceba.png[/img]

As I whirled around, three otherworldly specter warrious materialized behind me. Startled, I stammered:

[b]Sheepy:[/b] "Wha... how did you sneak up on me like that?!?"

[b]Wraith: [/b][i]"Unlike your mortal kind, we are not bound to the physical plane. Unbound, we and glide through the shadows. There lies our advantage."[/i]

I did my best to regain my composure. After all, I'm a professional! 

[b]Sheepy:[/b] "Were you alive once? What happened to you?"

[b]Wraith:[/b] [i]"In our mortal days, we roamed as band of mercenaries. Death claimed us on the battlefield, as fate decreed. Yet beyond death's grasp, our unity endured unbroken. The eternal rest veils us, for an unyielding hunger for combat pulls us back, compelling our return to satisfy this endless thirst."[/i]

[b]Sheepy: [/b]"What drew you to join the Dark Army and the Alliance?"

[b]Wraith: [/b][i]"Vez'nan promised us the symphony of screams and blood that our souls crave. For us, the prospect of battle and an enemy to vanquish is a call we cannot ignore; it is all that we need to heed the eternal call to arms."[/i]

Wrapping up the eerie encounter with the Grim Wraiths, I couldn't shake off the chill that clung to the air like a haunting melody. 

These Wraiths believe in nothing, and answer to no-one. It's a good thing they are on our side... for they are a powerful ally and a dreadful enemy. Their extraordinary powers surpass even the wildest dreams of the living.

Note to self: perhaps a less spooky interview next time.

[i]Sheepy out![/i]

notes.title: Lumenir and the Valiant Paladin Knights
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/f1874511db2d6b74b5122932a834969481879155.png[/img]
Hello General! Welcome to our weekly interview of the ranks in the Alliance camp!

I best be on my best behavior today, for I'm meeting none other than the avatar of justice: the majestic dragon Lumenir and her sworn Paladin Order.

The clouds appeared to part as I approached their campsite, a celestial sun ray gleaming down upon their camping site.

Their barracks, colossal and grand, embellished with flags and celestial symbols, gave an air of a castle rather than a temporary structure.

Three Paladins were standing guard on the entrance of the barrack's wooden door. As I approached, they fell to their knees and kneeled solemnly, leaning on their swords.

[b]Sheepy: [/b]“You're too gallant, but you don't need to kneel to before…”

I couldn’t finish the sentence, as I heard a thunderous stomp echo behind me. I turned, only to discover that the reverence was not meant for me. I too, knelt in awe before the towering form of the luminous blue dragon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/3df98a7871519012e5d8c75c615a7f5293fe0104.jpg[/img]

[b]Lumenir:[/b] [i]“RISE, BRIGHT SOULS.”
[/i]
The trio of paladins responded in unison: “Let there be light!”

[b]Sheepy: [/b]"I appreciate you taking the time for this interview. It's not often that I have the opportunity to meet the legendary Lightbringer herself, or members of such a distinguished ancient Order. How did it all begin?"

[b]Lumenir: [/b]"[i]AGES PAST, A FEARLESS KNIGHT NAMED SOL GRACED THE REALM WITH HIS NOBLE AND RIGHTFUL DEEDS. HIS COURAGE AND HONOR INSPIRED ME TO VIEW HUMANS WITH RENEWED HOPE.[/i]

[b]Lumenir:[/b] [i]"I BESTOWED MY BLESSING UPON HIM, THUS MARKING THE BEGINNING OF AN ORDER DEDICATED TO ILLUMINATING THE KINGDOM AND CLEANSING THE LAND."
[/i]
[b]Sir Hansi:[/b] "For millennia, our Paladin Order has strived to emulate Sol and prove ourselves deserving of the Lightbringer's blessing."

[b]Sir Kiske:[/b] “Our entire lives are devoted to this sacred mission. Lumenir's light shines the brightest, and grants us powers to smite thy evil”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/8b5015374d95d84d113a03092fa968ce13a5ae14.png[/img]

[b]Sheepy: [/b]“Do you only bless Paladins, Lumenir?”

[b]Lumenir: [/b][i]“I BESTOW MY BLESSINGS UPON THOSE WITH PURE HEARTS,  WHO STRIVE TO BRING JUSTICE AND KINDNESS TO THE LAND. SELDOM THERE'S ANY MORE DESERVING THAN PALADIN SWORN AND TRAINED TO UPHOLD THESE VIRTUES.”[/i]

[b]Sheepy:[/b] “I see. I hope you don't take this the wrong way… What about Vez'nan’s crusade? Where were you then, Lumenir?”
[b]
Lumenir:[/b] [i]“I AM ANCIENT, YOUNG ONE. I HAVE LIVED FOR MANY EONS AND FOUGHT COUNTLESS BATTLES. I MUST USE MY ENERGY WISELY, ONLY FOR THE MOST PERILOUS OF THREATS. MY KNIGHTS PROTECT THE LAND IN MY STEAD”.[/i]

[b]Sir Udo:[/b] “It was a dark time for our Order. We must humbly confess that we had become vain and prideful, and paid the price for it. Now, we have returned to the ways of old, faithfully guided by the light of the Lightbringer once more. We won't falter”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/a01c3fdf336e5b032b433d9ec1c46954c25dad95.png[/img]

Filled with determination, ferocity, and justice, they all emanated an unwavering resolve. I concluded the interview then, satisfied with everything I had learned.

[b]Lumenir: [/b][i]“SHINE ON, SHEEPY.”[/i]

Back in my tent, I carefully studied my notes, trying to grasp the enormity of having such an ancient order and revered deity fighting on our side.

It was clear that Lumenir and her Knights were the beacons of hope we needed to defeat the darkness. It is said that the power of kindness and justice always prevails, after all.
Would they accept sheep in their ranks? I wonder...

[i]Sheepy out![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/6b04c00ed2920d9e6da42e879bbafe2fcc9452d8.jpg[/img]

How about we make an [i]Alliance [/i]with Whales and Dolphins? 
[b]Let's support WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation for World Ocean Day! [/b]

[h2]Who is WDC?[/h2]
[b]WDC, Whale and Dolphin conservation[/b] is the leading global charity dedicated to the protection and conservation of whales and dolphins. 

Their expert-led teams in the UK, Europe, the Americas, and Australasia work across the whole spectrum of threats, from climate breakdown to accidental entanglements in fishing gear. They bring together, and work hand-in-hand with, businesses, philanthropists, scientists, NGOs, governments and grassroots communities to find solutions to the problems faced by whales and dolphins.
Their aim is to reverse the global decline in whale and dolphin populations by creating safe seas for these majestic creatures.

Entanglement in fishing gear, or ‘bycatch’ as it’s known, is the biggest threat whales and dolphins face. Many hundreds of thousands die in nets or get tangled up in fishing gear every year. As air-breathing mammals like us, when they get trapped in a net, panic can take over and they can sustain terrible injuries before either escaping, or suffocating. It is a massive problem and so WDC is working on some innovative solutions.  


[h2]What WDC has been doing so far 
[/h2]Working across the globe to protect whales, dolphins and porpoises from dying in fishing gear: 
[list]
[*] They’re collaborating with creel fishers in Scotland to trial new types of fishing gear to reduce entanglements of humpback and minke whales. 
[*] They’re working with colleagues and partner organisations in the Central Baltic Sea to develop a recovery plan for a critically endangered group of Baltic harbour porpoises. 
[*] On the west coast of the United States, critically endangered North Atlantic right whales are facing extinction. Entanglement is a massive threat to their survival, and WDC have been working with fishers to trial alternative gear types. 
[*] In Hong Kong WDC have been supporting local community efforts and working with fishers to save the remaining 200 Indo-Pacific finless porpoises from extinction due to bycatch.   
[*] These projects are saving lives, and they are powered by inspiring people working together for the ocean. 
[/list]

[h2]How your support will help this year
[/h2][b]By purchasing games from[url=https://bit.ly/WODSteamSale24] this year’s World Ocean Day sale[/url][/b], you will help WDC continue these vital conservation projects across the globe, as well as enable WDC’s team to embark on new efforts to bring further protections for whales and dolphins, like the Sri Lankan gillnet fisheries project: 
[list]
[*]  Sri Lanka is home to many species of whales, dolphins and porpoises as well as a myriad of other sensitive marine species like sea turtles that are vulnerable to entanglement in gillnets – these are nets that hang in the water like a wall. With funding, WDC hopes to collaborate with Sri Lankan artisanal tuna fisheries that use gillnets to trial new gear types and reduce the impact their fishing has on marine life, while still enabling them to earn their living. 
[/list]

Whales and dolphins are awe-inspiring. They are intelligent beings, vital for the health of the ocean and planet. Together we can still help them recover and flourish and they can help us reconnect with the wild, and repair the damage we have caused.

Keep up to date with all the awesome gaming activities WDC does [url=https://games.whales.org/ ]here.[/url]
And you can find many other amazing games in the sale [url=https://bit.ly/WODSteamSale24]here.[/url]

[b]Thank you for joining us and for supporting WDC! [/b]

notes.title: Get Ready to Bro Down with Broden!
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/de370560e81bd29dcba827f15af3e9e2596eda9a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/03790f97bc7be6d1f992ddadb0d38578e0b62ee7.png[/img][/url]
Hello General! Your favorite ovine reporter’s been invited to interview none other than [b]Broden, the fearless dwarven Gryphon rider! [/b]

Finding Broden’s backyard on the Linirean Camp was a breeze, thanks to the MASSIVE Linirean flag waving like it’s the 4th of July. As I got closer, Broden swooped down from his Gryphon to greet me.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/7884f111a4aa1bf37aa4f7adff3b4eff2deaad2a.jpg[/img]

[b]Broden: [/b]"Alright, listen up, little woolly buddy. You and me, we’re gonna have a real talk. You’re ready for some BBQ?"

I reached for the vegan option as I searched my notebook for questions.

[b]Sheepy:[/b] “Let’s start with your Gryphon. How did you two become such a dynamic duo?”

[b]Broden: [/b]“Ah, Liberty... she ain't just any Gryph, she’s my partner! I was a young dwarf honing my aim in the mountains when a stray bullet rang out, and I heard a squawk like no other. I tracked it down and found the most majestic beast I’d ever seen. Couldn't just leave her there! I Nursed her back to health for countless days and nights. We've been inseparable ever since. ”

[b]Sheepy: [/b]“Most dwarves love their gadgets, but you're all about firepower and your feathered friend. What's the deal with that?”

[b]Broden: [/b]“The Dwarven Air Force? Hah! They’re too busy fiddling with flying machines and playing with their toys since Wilbur whipped up that contraption. Me? I'm old school – Liberty and my guns is all I need.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/b377ebfe4424774be97f7ecc33fe092082f9ccd6.png[/img]
Sheepy: "Final question: What made you join the Alliance?"

[b]Broden: [/b] "If it were up to me, I’d be unloading my clips on those home-invading Dark Army scumbags. But as much as I despise 'em, I love my Linirea more. So, I signed up to rain hell on those cultists to protect my homeland."

Broden grew bored of the interview and gestured toward the sky.

[b]Broden:[/b] "Hey, enough talk! How about a spin on Liberty? Hold tight, we're about to fly like it's doomsday!"

I hopped on Liberty's back, clutching onto Broden's waist as we shot into the sky. The wind roared in my ears as we barrel-rolled through clouds, Broden's laughter mingling with Liberty's victory screeches. 

At that moment, high above the world, wind rushing through my fur as we soared through the skies, I realized that freedom, true freedom, is worth fighting for.

[i]Sheepy, out![/i]

notes.title: Meet the Mystical Elven Stargazer
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/8a0edb71fa49a34d47b944e8c6f4f15fa4ed48a5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/7cf803fb022e420be56fddb3aff13d32775c8ebb.png[/img][/url]

Welcome back to our weekly interview with your favorite four-legged reporter!

I'm over the moon because I'm meeting with Selenir, the mystical Elven Stargazer. She's a priestess who harnesses cosmic energies to fight for our Alliance - a true force to be reckoned with.

The Stargazing temple was a sight to behold, even from a distance. 

A simple yet mesmerizing stone platform overrun with rich green moss, it radiated an incredible power. As I approached the steps of the temple, I heard a soft voice speaking from the center of the structure. 

[b]Selenir: [/b]"Hail, traveler of the flock. I sense the light of curiosity shining in you".

[b]Sheepy:  [/b]"My pleasure! Thank you for agreeing to this interview!"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/7ee3c3e570a98d335f031d19c4ecfbef61087251.png[/img]

[b]Sheepy: [/b]"Can you tell us more about the cosmic energies you work with? Are they connected to the void? 

[b]Selenir: [/b]"My power originates from the Cosmos - the moon, stars, and other celestial bodies forever at play, orbiting in the cosmic dance of the universe."

The priestess gestured at the sky, eyes wide with wonder. "Space may seem lifeless, but it's imbued with energy, forever in flux. The Void, on the other hand, is a realm of darkness, unknown and dangerous. I steer clear of its treachery".

[b]Sheepy: [/b]"I see. Many believe that elves draw their magic from nature. Is that connected to your power as well?"

[b]Selenir (smiling sadly): [/b]"That used to be true before our world was plagued with tragedies…  the corruption of the Tear of Elynie, the loss of our dragon, war, and destruction. We were all of a sudden disconnected from the source."

With a heavy heart, she added after a long pause:

[b]Selenir: [/b]"So many Elves fell to despair. Their path became aimless and their hearts darkened inside. It pains me deeply... my people have lost their way."

[b]Sheepy: [/b]"I’m so sorry. You seem to have found yours, though."

[b]Selenir: [/b]"Often, when you are lost, you feel disconnected from the universe. Alone. Yet the Stars and Moon reminded me that I had always belonged, and I found my place again in the family of things."

[b]Sheepy: [/b] "Is that why you decided to become a priestess?"

[b]Selenir:[/b] "Yes, my path led me to the realization that there are infinite sentient beings still lost, seeking meaning. I swore a solemn bow to guide them and protect them all from harm. It’s the reason I’m fighting in our Alliance."

[b]Sheepy: [/b]"Your resilience and dedication are truly remarkable. Thank you for sharing your wisdom with me."

[b]Selenir: [/b]"May the stars guide and protect you, young one. "

As darkness fell, Selenir cast a light orb that guided my path back to my tent. Once I was safely home, her magic dissolved into stardust, twinkling as it slowly floated in the air - a mesmerizing and magical sight. 

I paused to reflect on the encounter. Selenir's words lingered in my mind, a reminder of the profound connections that bind us all, even in times of great despair. I thanked the stars for bringing such a strong ally to our cause, feeling a renewed sense of purpose, by the light of the moon.

[i]Sheepy out!
[/i]

notes.title: Meet the Goblins Behind the Ultimate War Machine
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/b37c82f4d6c9a1b2787f08d58c130300828369db.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/60fb551c259226d5f8d61de2c1ebde7345800fae.png[/img][/url]

Hello once again, General! It's your favorite ovine reporter, bringing you the Alliance's latest news. Let's continue getting to know our ranks. 

Today, I'm interviewing none other than Chim and Churri, the goblin cousins conducting the infamous Onagro war machine.

I know exactly where to find them: in the heart of the Dark Army encampment, amidst the clang of metal and the rumble of machinery.

When they noticed me approaching, the two goblin tinkerers paused their handiwork to greet me.

[b]Sheepy:[/b] “Thank you for agreeing to my interview!”

[b]Churri: [/b] “Buckle up! This is gonna get interesting.“

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/111a3e37442965af173af58937004be1c6facb65.jpg[/img]
I gestured towards the imposing figure of Onagro looming just outside the tent.

[b]Sheepy: [/b]"So, tell me about the inspiration behind your giant mecha. How did you come up with THAT?"

[b]Chim: [/b]"Well, you see, Sheepy, it all started with a little bit of goblin madness and a whole lot of stolen dwarven doodads!"

[b]Churri: [/b](nodding enthusiastically). "Oh, yeah! We mixed and mashed for a whole day and night until we got Onagro, the ultimate war machine! Care for a tour?"

Churri showed me around, pointing out the heavy arsenal aboard the imposing wood and metal war machine. Chim followed closely, looking proud.

[b]Churri: [/b] "We've got bombs, we've got mines, we've got rockets, we've got a goblin zeppelin to provide cover fire - all the good stuff to make Onagro the most badass greenskin war machine in the land!"

[b]Sheepy:[/b] "Well, it certainly sounds impressive! But I have to ask, how did you come up with the name Onagro?"

[b]Chim:[/b] "Believe it or not, 'ona' means 'big' in goblin, and 'gro' is short for 'grot', which is our word for goblin. So, put them together and you get 'big goblin'!"

[b]Churri:[/b] "Or you could just say, it sounded cool and scary, and that's how we roll!"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/50d375ec84c7ae8557b7861096506f407bb8bf7a.png[/img]

[b]Sheepy: [/b]"I see. It's truly fearsome. But why must you two man the vehicle?"

[b]Chim: [/b]"I'm the pilot, my part is to manouver at full throttle on the battlefield."

[b]Churri: [/b]"The fun part's all mine! I send our  bombs, mines, and rockets a flying toward our foes like a bunch of angry bees! Buzz, buzz, boom, baby!"

Churri was so excited he couldn't stop talking. "And I always try to add new weapons and gadgets to our arsenal! Like, last week I came up with this awesome idea for a flamethrower. Chim wasn't too sure about it though."

[b]Chim [/b](rolling his eyes): "Yeah, because the last time we tried your 'awesome idea', we almost blew up the entire mecha! Remember that, Churri?"

Churri waved him off with a dismissive grin, "Pshh, details, details.”

I thanked them for their time, still laughing at their antics,

As I looked around at Onagro's various weapons and gadgets, I realized just how much thought and ingenuity these pair of goblins put into every single aspect of this mechanical marvel. Seeing them rollin’ in perfect sync is a sight to behold!

[i]Sheepy out!
[/i]

notes.title: Meet the Demon Pit imps!
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/1ca36b2a7c56f3c6ead734273fe93d7111dd8005.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/51d5e88465ad26759f6cf420830364131260b38b.png[/img][/url]
Good day, everyone! This is Sheepy, reporting live from the Alliance Camp. 

Today, I've got quite a hot interview for you all. I'm about to venture into the Dark Army camp to interview none other than the imps from the Demon Pit. Let's see what they have to say!

It’s usually pretty easy to find them. You just have to follow the smoke trail visible from miles away. 

Look, there they are!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/fa849a76bd45f6d4e823d8b22076db7c2d0386c7.jpg[/img]

[b]Miguel:[/b] Well, well, well, look who's come to visit us. What brings a fluffy reporter like you to our humble abode?

[b]Sheepy: [/b]I’m interviewing the ranks, and getting to know our Alliance better. What brought you here?

[b]Miguel: [/b](chuckling) It's quite the tale. Us demons got sent to dig up gold in the dwarven mines to expand the Dark Lord’s treasury. But we didn’t mine for very long.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/ad1a19438dd5522a52bb9e035b34aa6fdf7a8ae2.jpg[/img]

[b]Sheepy: [/b]And what happened?

[b]Miguel: [/b](smirking) One day, we stumbled upon this magnificent lava spring deep in the mines. And let me tell you, it was like finding paradise. We realized that we didn't have to hate our jobs anymore. 

[b]Imp:[/b] Let's just say we found our true calling: relaxation!

[b]Sheepy:[/b] So you turned the Demon Pit into your own personal spa retreat?

[b]Miguel: [/b]You could say that. Why slave away in the dark when you can relax in the warm glow of molten lava? We may still have to fight, but at least now we do it on our terms. And let me tell you, this lava pool does wonders for the complexion!

The other imps nod in agreement, some lazily floating on inflatable rafts

[b]Sheepy: [/b]And what about your new abilities, such as explosive damage? How did those come about?

[b]Miguel: [/b](grinning) Ah, those are just a few perks of our improved working conditions. Plus, a steady diet of lava fumes does wonders for your explodability.

[b]Sheepy: [/b]Fascinating! And I hear you hold the record for the best fighter with a towel?

[b]Miguel: [/b](proudly puffing out his chest) No one can wield a towel like I can. It's just one of the many talents I've developed since we upgraded our workplace.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/4bad24db2c1596529f69f972ae3cdf03a570cec7.jpg[/img]

I thanked them for their time and wandered off, feeling a sense of warmth both from the hot air and the unexpectedly charming encounter with Miguel and his crew.

As I strolled back towards my tent, I reflected on the imps' approach to life. After all, amidst the chaos of battle, finding moments of relaxation and joy is essential for maintaining one's sanity! 

Perhaps I should consider joining Miguel and his crew for a dip in the lava pool a couple of times a week?

[i]Sheepy out!
[/i]

notes.title: An Interview with the Arboreans
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/1738a5382a02b1ef39e11d6f162104cc7a0576c0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/3e4c01e3e0553d27225497db179c9d6c0319d3c7.png[/img][/url]

Ahhh… the atmosphere in the Linirean sector of the camp is so serene!

Humans, Elves, Dwarves, and various other peoples congregate beneath the banner of the Lion. Their races have a long history of working together and have been collaborating for centuries.

In contrast, the Arboreans are newcomers to the Linirean ranks.  But you wouldn’t be able to tell so from the way they seamlessly blend in.

Their amiable, peaceful ways make them easy to get along with. 

The camp bustles with Arboreans of all ages and sizes. Despite their numbers, they are a quiet people that mostly keep to themselves. Little is known of them, and their kind remains a mystery to most.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/984f6c83eba65d4a483617062d427a964392edb7.png[/img]

But not for long! I, Sheepy, the intrepid Ovine Reporter, am determined to interview these magic beings of nature and delve deeper into their wisdom. 

As I approached them, the Arborean Emissary nodded at me solemnly, and Nyru's eyes twinkled with mischief as he greeted me. "Sheepy! About time you interviewed us!"

[b]Sheepy:[/b] “What can you tell me about your kind, the Arboreans?”

[b]Emissary:[/b] “We are beings born from the living, beating Heart of the Everadiant Forest. Our corporeal forms can be borrowed from elements of our surroundings such as bark, leaves, and rock…”

[b]Nyru: [/b]“Some of us resemble humanoids as a result of imitating foreign travelers. Like I did! I thought legs looked funny.”

[b]Emissary: [/b]“Either way, when our time is done, we’ll become one with earth and soil, and our lifecycle begins anew.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/51d12fcd463947240387628d50b0e1025f1ff5c0.jpg[/img]

[b]Sheepy:[/b] "But how long is that? By the looks of Nyru, he can’t be more than ten…"

Nyru laughed. “Guess again” he said “I’ve been protecting this forest for hundreds of years. Or lifespans are far greater than those of regular lifeforms.”

[b]Sheepy:[/b] “That’s fascinating. I had never met an Arborean before I came to Everadiant.”

[b]Emissary: [/b]“Our lifes are dedicated to tending for this Forest, so it is uncommon for our kind to travel far from home”

“Some of us are more curious than others though…” - added Nyru, smiling.

[b]Sheepy: [/b]Why did you join the alliance?

[b]Emissary: [/b]“Even though we are caretakers, we will not hesitate to use the powerful forces of nature to defend the land we nurture against threats.”

[b]Nyru: [/b]“As of late, Wildbeasts have become more hostile against our kind, creating chaos across the forest. Their leader, Goregrind, commands his forces to take over the forest and carve a path to its core, where the Heart is.”

[b]Emissary:[/b] “We must protect the Heart, the source of our life and all of Everadiant's. For you see, we are one and the same, and we shall all share its fate. "

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/1ca36b2a7c56f3c6ead734273fe93d7111dd8005.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/51d5e88465ad26759f6cf420830364131260b38b.png[/img][/url]
The interview with the Arboreans left me with a profound realization: we are all interconnected. Just as the roots of the Everadiant Forest intertwine, so too are we bound to one another. 

We would even share a fate with the Dark Army, were the world to wall under the Overseer's control. I understood it better than ever: we must be united, despite our differences. 

[i]Sheepy out!
[/i]

notes.title: An interview with Raelyn
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/9f1d91ed2f7efee6a4e1a7851d21b07421fe1723.jpg[/img]

There is someplace in camp where a deadly silence reigns, and no quarrels dare arise. Linireans and Dark Army alike hesitate to approach Raelyn and her Dark Knights. 

Still, I was set to interview her, since surely the Commander of the Dark Army assigned by Vez’nan himself would shed some light on this newfound Alliance — and how to keep it together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/db928a14fc65160404e767210439bf64331fa238.png[/img]
[b]"WHO GOES THERE???"
[/b]
A voice echoed deeply from the helmet, startling me. His sudden appearance sent a shiver down my spine. I couldn't help but notice the heart-shaped tattoo with the letter "R" emblazoned on his arm. They must love her fiercely. I swallowed hard, trying to gather my courage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/e642332d8680444b3637b39ab984e7f60ec4b239.png[/img]
[i]“I-I'm Sheepy. Here to interview Raelyn.”
[/i]
The Dark Knight regarded me with fiery red eyes, their gaze piercing through me. For a moment, I feared they would turn me away, but to my surprise, they stepped aside and motioned for me to enter the enclave. [b]“SHE’LL  SEE YOU"[/b], he rumbled in a deep, gravelly voice.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/2b6cba42127e61ded007e94de4211a7a553b1a3d.png[/img]
[b]"Make it quick, I don't have all day."
[/b]
Glowing red eyes greeted me, dripping with contempt. 

[i]“Right, understood. How did you ascend to command the Dark Army?”
[/i]
Her gaze pierces through the dim light, her features obscured by shadows.

[b]"My origins are inconsequential, but know this: I emerged as a Squire and swiftly ascended ranks to Dark Knight during Vez'nan's victorious Crusade."

"I was entrusted with the leadership of a specialized unit against the mightiest adversaries. The success of my squadron was such that the Dark Lord himself demanded my presence within his innermost circle."

"And now, here I stand."[/b]

[i]“But how do you cultivate such  devotion among your knights?”
[/i]

[/i]
